desc: Derive the reformulation: mid distinct count for (i+1..j) = #{k in [i+1..j] : prev[k] <= i}, where prev[k] is previous occurrence index of A[k] (0 if none).

Design the sweep: segment tree over i in [1..N-1] initialized with prefix-distinct P[i]; for j=2..N-1, range-add +1 on [max(1,prev[j]), j-1], then candidate = suffix-distinct Suf[j+1] + max over i in [1..j-1]; track global max.
Implement solve() in Python with fast I/O (sys.stdin.buffer) and a lazy segment tree, O(N log N) time, O(N) memory.

Validate against samples (5 and 9) and stress-test against an O(N^3) brute force for N <= 12 with random values in [1..N], including edge cases all-equal (answer 3) and all-distinct (answer N); finalize code block.
